item.title: Rensai☆Kisou Camellia Note ~Yume ni Shinobazu, Kirisake Otome!~
item.description:
ゲーム情報

  • ブランド: tritail
  • 発売日: 2011-03-31
  • スコア: 6.81/10 (15 人評価)
  • 日本語名: 恋祭☆綺想カメリアノート ～夢に忍ばず、斬り咲け乙女！～
  • 英語名: Rensai☆Kisou Camellia Note Yume ni Shinobazu, Kirisake Otome!

あらすじ

Shouichi is a normal student at Raikou Gakuen, which holds an event called Meikousai where students fight for ‘camellia pages’ which hold mysterious power, with the winner getting their wish granted. Even though Shouichi lost his camellia page pretty early, he found himself still stuck on the battlefield.

item.title: Majo☆Puri ~Anata no Seieki, Zenbu Shiboritotte Agechau!~
item.description:
ゲーム情報

  • ブランド: tritail
  • 発売日: 2010-02-26
  • スコア: 6.33/10 (11 人評価)
  • 日本語名: まじょ☆プリ～アナタの精液、ぜんぶ搾り取ってあげちゃう！～
  • 英語名: Majo☆Puri Anata no Seieki, Zenbu Shiboritotte Agechau!

别名

  • Majo Pri

あらすじ

Koichi just lives a peaceful life… But one day, two girls suddenly appears in front of him, Elza and Clarissa. They are actually the princesses of the magic world and came to this world on a mission, “Let’s have sex and have a baby…!” To be the queen, they will need to give birth to a baby with Koichi’s semen, who has special family history. This means they are Koichi’s fiancees… Koichi is confused, but their full of sex life starts…
